analysis: The trial executed successfully but achieved macro validation HR@10 of 0.4912, below the supplied uniform-BCE reference of 0.5325 by 0.0413 and reported best of 0.5387 by 0.0475. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.535, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.545, Electronics 0.380, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.505. The equal mixture of uniform and detached hard-negative weighting did not improve this experiment. Emphasizing high-scoring sampled negatives may over-penalize plausible unseen items or change optimization unfavorably; the supplied results do not establish the cause. GPU allocation was 594.33 seconds. No held-out test conclusion is available.
code_summary: One independently trained ConvRec model per category, with tied 96-dimensional item embeddings, item biases, length-64 histories, and four residual causal convolution blocks using dilations 1/2/4/8 and dropout 0.25. A gated projection of cumulative mean item embeddings adds prefix memory before final layer normalization. Training uses random and terminal prefix windows, AdamW, seed 42, 256 shared sampled negatives, and at most 2,048 supervised positions per batch. The sole experimental change mixes uniform negative weights equally with detached masked softmax weights at temperature 1.0 for negative softplus loss; positive BCE remains unchanged. Validation selects one checkpoint per category, and the exported predictor strictly reconstructs and loads that single model for routing. No ensembles or separately fitted scoring components are used.
